_comment: chirp ground (NFM) daemon defaults. Phase 4a defaults + Phase 4b 'sdr' block. Separate UDP port + state path + hit log + icecast fallback from airband so the two daemons can coexist. See chirp/config/README.md.

sdr._comment: SDR source defaults for ground. SB7 (M1, macOS): ground moved OFF the RSPduo SL tuner (the old MA/SL device_args below is retired dead config — SL required a Master already open on the same physical RSPduo, and SB7's device map runs airband ST-only on its own RSPduo with no MA/SL at all). Ground now runs on its own dedicated RTL-SDR (serial 61108285, the most-reliable attached dongle per etc/mac/sdr_fleet_policy.json). gr-osmosdr addresses RTL by its NATIVE 'rtl=<serial>' source type, not soapy=driver=rtlsdr (verified empirically on the M1, 2026-07-06: 'built-in source types: ... rtl ... soapy ...' — rtl is the dedicated osmosdr backend). No bandwidth_hz needed for RTL (0 = driver default; the SDRplay-master-mode bandwidth requirement that broke airband doesn't apply to RTL's architecture). center_freq_hz set to 138.05 MHz (177th Fighter Wing — the busiest ground channel by far in rtl-airband's stats).
